title: 邀请美国朋友来家里烧烤，英语怎么说？
summary: 夏天办 BBQ 是美国人的传统。这篇教你发出邀请、问客人带什么，以及客人该说什么。

featuredPhrase.en: We're having a BBQ this Saturday. Want to come?
featuredPhrase.zh: 我们这周六有个烧烤聚会。想来吗？

phrases.en: We're having a BBQ this Saturday. Want to come?
phrases.zh: 我们这周末有个烧烤聚会。想来吗？
请在周五前回复是否参加。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi John! We're having a BBQ this Saturday. Want to come?
dialogue.zh: 你好 John！我们这周六有个烧烤聚会。想来吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: 4 pm. It's BYOB, by the way.
dialogue.zh: 下午 4 点。顺便说下，自带酒水。

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.en: Got it. Can I bring anything?
dialogue.zh: 知道了。我需要带点什么吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Just yourselves! Maybe a dessert if you like.
dialogue.zh: 人来就行！喜欢的话可以带个甜点。

seoTitle: 邀请朋友烧烤英文怎么说？
seoDescription: 怎么用英语邀请美国朋友来家里 BBQ？本文教你发出邀请、BYOB 等说法，附完整对话。
